title: Custom widget
description: Register a project-local widget and use it like any built-in.

props.title: Bring your own widgets
props.subtitle: The Callout below is defined in this project (src/widgets/Callout.astro) and registered via config. Content references it by name, exactly like a built-in widget.

props.title: This is a project widget
props.text: It consumes a Parche primitive (Icon) and the design-system tokens, so it themes and styles consistently with everything else.
